# JobDex

> Open-source global index of startup hiring by city. Aggregates job listings from 10+ ATS providers including (YCombinator, Greenhouse and more), then plots them on an interactive world map. Free, open source and no login required.

## Pages

- [Home](https://jobdex.1mindlabs.org/): Landing page with project overview and globe visualization
- [Map](https://jobdex.1mindlabs.org/map): Interactive world map with city and company-level job pins, search and role/remote filters
- [How It Works](https://jobdex.1mindlabs.org/how-it-works): Explains the ingestion pipeline, ATS coverage and data freshness

## API

- [OpenAPI Schema](https://jobdex-api.1mindlabs.org/openapi.json): Machine-readable API spec for all endpoints (jobs, companies, cities, map, search, stats)
- [API Reference](https://jobdex-api.1mindlabs.org/docs): Interactive REST API docs. Fully public, no authentication required.
- [Platform Stats](https://jobdex-api.1mindlabs.org/stats): Live aggregate counts: total companies, jobs, cities, ATS breakdown, top regions

## Optional

- [Legal](https://jobdex.1mindlabs.org/legal): Legal notices and disclaimers
- [Privacy Policy](https://jobdex.1mindlabs.org/privacy-policy): Data handling and privacy practices
- [Terms of Service](https://jobdex.1mindlabs.org/terms-of-service): Terms governing use of the platform
- [FAQ](https://jobdex.1mindlabs.org/faq): Common questions about data sources, update frequency and coverage
- [GitHub](https://github.com/areebahmeddd/jobdex): Source code, issue tracker and contribution guide (MIT license)
